name: Stay and Work Permit (single permit) for Third-Country Nationals

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a job offer from a Croatian employer, who must obtain the appropriate authorisation (stay-and-work permit or work registration certificate) before employment begins.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a confirmed job offer from a Croatian employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Most positions require the employer to request a labour market test and opinion from the Croatian Employment Service; this is waived for professions on the Employment Service's 'high demand' list, for permit extensions with the same employer/worker, for seasonal work up to 90 days/year, and for certain categories including key personnel, self-employed individuals, and EU Blue Card holders.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract or confirmed job offer
Labour market test result or applicable exemption

sources.title: Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova Republike Hrvatske (mup.gov.hr) -- Work of third-country nationals

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Croatia's initial build. HONEST GAP: the source page fetched does not state a standard permit duration or a minimum salary threshold -- both are said to be governed by specific articles of the Aliens Act (Official Gazette 133/20, 114/22, 151/22) not retrieved in full in this pass; duration_length left null rather than guessed. Employers face fines of EUR 6,630-13,270 per worker for unauthorised employment, confirming enforcement is real but not itself a qualifying condition. pr_after_months (60) and leads_to_citizenship follow this route's residence feeding into hr_long_term_residence's 5-year test, per that route's own sourcing, not from this source directly. A separate, less-tested 'EU Blue Card' (highly-qualified third-country nationals) track exists per mup.gov.hr but was not built as its own route file in this pass -- a scope decision, not an oversight, since figures for it were not fetched. work_rights set to 'restricted' (schema enum: tied to the specific employer/position named in the permit, detail carried here rather than in the enum); study_rights 'none' (no study entitlement described for this route); duration_length left as an explicit 'not specified' string rather than a guessed figure.
